# kind-read fixtures

Plain-text extracts of Wikipedia page summaries, fetched 2026-09-27 from the
REST summary endpoint (`https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/<Title>`),
kept verbatim so `native/tests/kind-read.test.js` reasons over fixed text.
Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.
